title: Effects of Prebiotic or Probiotic Supplements on Symptoms of Functional Constipation
brief_summary: This study intends to evaluate the effects of three prebiotic solid beverages (mainly dietary fiber and prebiotics) and one probiotic solid beverage on the laxative effect of patients with functional constipation through randomized controlled trials. The influence of tract flora is expected to provide a basis for related therapies for patients with functional constipation.
